Chetehavni / Disclaimer

Ye advisory INSAT-3DR satellite SST + wind aur MarineRegions EEZ par adharit hai. Hamesha local weather forecast, Indian Coast Guard / INCOIS ke notices, monsoon fishing ban (61 din) aur apni boat ki capacity zaroor check karein.
